Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.

Shatter

Crush (Ace) has a capability/ability to break shields instantly, regardless of how many amount of instances the enemies had. He is great for shield enemies or Shield Challenges. However, he can't hit flying, so for flying enemies with shields, use Karyn, Elf Spirit (Wind), Hammerhead (Shark Empress), or Gravity Navy (Admiral).
